metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects SQL injection patterns in authentication forms that bypass login controls
properties.query: let sqli_patterns = dynamic(["' OR 1=1", "' OR '", "admin'--", "1; DROP", "UNION SELECT", "' UNION", "1=1", "OR TRUE"]); AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'waf' | where RequestQuery has_any (sqli_patterns) or RequestBody has_any (sqli_patterns) | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group, SourceIP | where count_ > 3
